description: For each Filter value in turn [N > 20 ;; S Like 'a*' ;; D > #1/1/2020# ;; D >= #2/20/2020 1:30:00 PM# ;; Q Is Null ;; Q Is Not Null ;; S = 'O''Brien' ;; N = 40 AND S = 'abc' ;; N IN (10, 70) ;; N BETWEEN 20 AND 40 ;; NOT N = 40 ;; 1 = 0 ;;  ;; N >> ;; NoSuchField = 1 ;; WHERE N > 20 ;; N > 20 ORDER BY N ;; S > 'b' ;; ID = '3' ;; N = Null ;; IsNull(S) ;; [N] > 20 ;; F.N > 20 ;; Null ;; Empty ;; Long 1]: open a fresh dynaset over F, assign Filter, read Filter back, call OpenRecordset() with no arguments into a derived recordset and walk ID to EOF from its first row; close both. Asks which Filter texts the property accepts at assignment, which are refused at the derived OpenRecordset, and the rows each derived recordset holds. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
